copy.release: The special premiere took place on October 9, 2026 at BlackBox in Beirut Media Zone, as reported by Nidaa al-Watan. Lebtalks reports a nationwide Lebanese cinema rollout planned from October 22; Cinemacity Beirut lists Thursday, October 22 as its opening date, with no sessions scheduled yet. An older March 19 database date is not the current release schedule.
copy.status: Status checked October 10, 2026: completed special premiere, planned public cinema opening and remaining availability gaps are separated below.
copy.confirmed: NMPRO and MTV jointly produced the film, directed by Nadim Mehanna with a screenplay by Claudia Marshalian. Jerry Ghazal plays the young Charbel. The October 9 special premiere at Beirut Media Zone has taken place. Lebtalks reported presidential patronage and MTV coverage; public cinema release across Lebanon is planned from October 22, supported by Cinemacity's own opening listing. Exact sessions should be checked with cinemas.
copy.source: elCinema: Charbel (2026) - film details; older date conflicts with its unreleased label
